data.scope: General work calendar for government administrative agencies. Lists only memorial days, festivals and substitute holidays that are actual days off; excludes regular weekends and commemorations without time off. Special agencies, schools, military institutions and private businesses follow their respective rules. Indigenous ceremonial holidays do not constitute days off for everyone. No holidays are inferred for years not included in this dataset.
